# SkillPanel

> > SkillPanel is a talent acquisition and upskilling platform specializing in technical recruitment, developer hiring, and workforce development through skills assessments and learning solutions.

The platform provides comprehensive resources for hiring tech talent, from pre-employment assessments to upskilling programs. Content draws on data from Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and industry research from Deloitte to guide recruitment optimization and developer evaluation.

## Key Topics

- Technical recruitment and developer hiring
- Pre-employment assessments and coding tests
- Upskilling platforms and workforce development
- HR analytics and hiring metrics
- Time-to-hire optimization
- Stack Overflow and GitHub data insights
- DevSkiller integration
- Programming languages (Java, Kotlin)
- Frontend and mobile app developer recruitment
- Social recruiting strategies
- Video interviewing tools
- Talent acquisition best practices
- Developer salary benchmarking
- Recruitment process optimization
- Employee recognition and retention

## Hiring Guides & Best Practices

- [The guide for pre-employment assessments](https://skillpanel.com/it/blog/pre-employment-assessments): Complete guide to pre-employment assessments and candidate evaluation
- [How to optimize your hiring process - DevSkiller](https://skillpanel.com/es/blog/optimize-hiring-process): Guide to optimizing recruitment process and reducing time-to-hire
- [How to optimize your hiring process - DevSkiller](https://skillpanel.com/it/blog/optimize-hiring-process): DevSkiller guide to recruitment optimization and efficiency
- [[Video]7 step formula to hire top tech talent Blog](https://skillpanel.com/fr/blog/tech-talent): Video guide: 7-step formula for hiring top tech talent faster
- [10 most common don'ts of hiring programmers](https://skillpanel.com/es/blog/10-most-common-donts-of-hiring-programmers): 10 common mistakes to avoid when hiring programmers
- [The 9-step guide to hire a mobile app developer - DevSkiller](https://skillpanel.com/jp/blog/hire-mobile-app-developer): 9-step guide for hiring iOS, Android, and cross-platform developers
- [The difference between a programmer and a developer: A recruiter's guide](https://skillpanel.com/it/blog/programmer-vs-developer): Recruiter's guide explaining programmer vs developer role differences
